common: Create a finished horizontal anime illustration with exactly two clearly adult women in their twenties, depicting affectionate friendship at the moment it begins to feel romantic. One woman makes a playful, confident advance; the other responds with her own subtle flirtation, welcoming eye contact and a bashful smile. The narrative must be readable from their distinct gestures, mutual gaze, body orientation and small distance between their faces, rather than from text. Sweet, tender, cute, non-explicit romantic tension. Fully clothed in coordinated but distinct elegant feminine fashion, with opaque bodices and lined skirts. Give both women clearly different hair colors, eye colors and silhouettes. Preserve clear readable faces, natural hands, coherent anatomy and exactly two arms per person. Use an asymmetrical horizontal wallpaper composition with gentle wide-angle environmental depth and foreground/background layering, but no distorted faces. Follow the scene-specific framing and action. Render the scene as one continuous illustration. No extra people, captions, speech bubbles, lettering, watermarks, collage, panels or decorative page border. The content and gesture instructions take priority over static poses suggested by the rendering style.

jobs.title: 同一本书里的小心思
jobs.scene: A warm sunlit antique bookshop, an intimate three-quarter view from the knees upward. Woman A has long chestnut-brown hair and amber eyes, a forest-green vintage dress with a cream lace collar and leather ankle boots. Woman B has shoulder-length silver-lavender hair and turquoise eyes, an ivory and dusty-blue ruffled dress with a dark blue ribbon and pale heeled shoes. A stands beside B and reaches past her to take one book from a high shelf, smiling with her face close to B's ear as if suggesting they read it together. B keeps her fingertips on that same book's lower edge and looks back at A, blushing, while gently catching the cuff of A's sleeve with her free hand. This is an unhurried mutual teasing interaction, with open space beside them. Strong but gentle near/far bookshelf perspective, floating dust in slanting golden afternoon light, crisp focal eyes and continuous hair shapes. Do not put any readable writing on the book spines.

jobs.title: 伞下故意靠近一点
jobs.scene: A rainy evening on a quiet lantern-lit garden path, full-body three-quarter composition with both pairs of shoes visible and reflected on wet stone. Woman A has long navy-blue hair in a loose ponytail and violet eyes, a deep plum Lolita dress, fitted short jacket and black high-heeled long boots. Woman B has wavy strawberry-blonde hair and emerald-green eyes, a cream and rose-pink Lolita dress, small capelet and burgundy heeled Mary Jane shoes. A holds one translucent umbrella over both of them and deliberately leans shoulder to shoulder with a mischievous smile, looking into B's eyes. B tilts her own body inward, shyly hooks two fingers around A's free hand, and smiles as if she has understood the invitation. Their linked hands are clearly visible between them. Falling rain outside the canopy, blue and warm pink reflections, soft distant lantern bokeh, gentle wind moving ribbons and skirt hems, vivid clean jewel-colored anime rendering.

jobs.title: 这一支舞只想邀你
jobs.scene: An airy moonlit conservatory ballroom, full figures with complete elegant high-heeled shoes. Woman A has very long black hair and pale blue eyes, a midnight-blue fitted ballroom dress with gold embroidery, a flared skirt and short cape sleeves. Woman B has long copper-red waves and amethyst eyes, an ivory and lilac dress with lace sleeves, a softly layered skirt and violet ribbons. A steps into a graceful half-turn and offers her palm upward with an inviting, affectionate smile, as if asking for a private dance. B places one hand lightly in that offered palm while her free hand secretly tugs a small fold of A's capelet closer, her eyes shyly meeting A's. Their bodies form an open turning arc rather than a static embrace. A few rose petals and curving skirts imply a small spin. Tall glass arches, climbing roses, a distant moon and pale reflections on marble, delicate colored-ink contours with luminous watercolor passages. No decorative outer frame.

jobs.title: 最后一口留给你
jobs.scene: A light-filled patisserie terrace, intimate seated waist-up view across a small round table; show the two women's separate hands clearly. Woman A has a soft rose-pink bob and aqua-blue eyes, wearing a white and raspberry-red lace dress with puffed sleeves. Woman B has long mint-green hair loosely tied back and warm gold eyes, wearing a lavender and cream dress with a green ribbon. A leans forward with a teasing smile and offers B one tiny piece of strawberry cake on a dessert fork held at a comfortable distance from B's lips. B willingly leans a little toward the fork, smiling shyly while her own free hand slides a second fork toward A's empty plate, hinting that she wants to feed A in return. Their eyes meet over the offered dessert. A single small cake plate and two cups, trailing roses, airy glass railings and a distant garden. Cool translucent color glazes, fresh pink highlights, large crisp expressive eyes and soft summer daylight. No contact with or licking the fork in this frame.

jobs.title: 替你系好的蝴蝶结
jobs.scene: A quiet vintage tram compartment at sunset, only the two women in the scene, seated beside one another in a three-quarter view from the knees upward. Woman A has a short dark-brown bob and green eyes, a warm caramel dress with an ivory blouse and lace cuffs. Woman B has long pale-blue braided hair and rose-colored eyes, a navy-blue and cream dress with a slightly loose ribbon bow at the collar. A turns toward B and carefully reties the bow with both hands, her expression gently teasing and attentive. B keeps her hands on her own lap but subtly shifts one hand toward A's knee without touching, then looks up into A's face with a small blush and an unmistakably welcoming smile. Their knees point toward each other. Golden window light, a softly blurred green landscape outside, a wicker bag on the floor and warm wooden fittings. Charming delicate anime drawing, quiet pastel color and restrained paper texture.

jobs.title: 花束之外还藏着邀请
jobs.scene: A bright romantic flower-shop greenhouse, a full-body three-quarter view with complete ankle boots and heeled pumps. Woman A has flowing golden-blonde hair and violet eyes, wearing a sage-green and ivory dress with a ribbon belt and cream heeled ankle boots. Woman B has long wine-red hair in a low ponytail and turquoise eyes, a dusty-rose skirt, white ruffled blouse, burgundy waistcoat and matching heeled pumps. A offers B a small hand-tied bouquet at chest height while leaning forward with a confident, amused smile. B accepts the bouquet with one hand, then gently pulls on A's sleeve cuff with her other hand as if asking her to stay and go somewhere together. B's head tilts, cheeks warm, eyes looking directly at A. The flowers remain below their faces so the interaction is visible. Curving greenhouse aisles, potted flowers and soft green framing, delicate tinted linework, clear lyrical silhouettes, dappled afternoon light and a light breeze moving hair and ribbons.

jobs.title: 牵住手之后的试探
jobs.scene: A spacious seaside promenade at vivid sunset, an asymmetrical full-body view with both women walking diagonally toward the viewer, complete shoes visible. Woman A has long silver-white hair and crimson eyes, wearing a navy and white sailor-inspired adult fashion dress with a fitted waist and black heeled ankle boots. Woman B has short tousled violet hair and golden eyes, a coral and cream dress with layered cuffs and white heeled Mary Jane shoes. A walks one half-step ahead, turning back with a bright teasing smile and reaching her hand behind her as an obvious invitation. B catches that offered hand with her fingertips, and then deliberately links their fingers more firmly, smiling and blushing as she leans slightly toward A. Show the joined hands clearly near the center and keep both faces turned toward each other. Sea wind, arcing ribbons, warm orange reflected light and deep turquoise shadows. Crisp anime contours, strong clean color separation and a dynamic but believable walking stride.

jobs.title: 烟花响起时的悄悄话
jobs.scene: An ornate lantern festival viewed from a quiet balcony above a distant city, exactly two women, intimate three-quarter framing from the hips upward. Woman A has long dark-teal hair and amber-orange eyes, wearing a midnight-purple Chinese-inspired Lolita dress with frog closures, cream lace and a small jade pendant. Woman B has long peach-pink hair in two loose side braids and clear sapphire eyes, wearing an ivory and blue dress with Chinese cloud embroidery and pearl hair clips. A leans beside B and lightly cups one hand beside her own mouth to whisper near B's ear with a mischievous smile. Her other hand rests on the railing. B turns her face toward A with a blush and a softly delighted smile, while one hand gently touches A's forearm as a quiet invitation to keep talking. Their faces are close but separate, eyes and lips unobscured. Behind them bloom cyan, violet and pale gold fireworks, suspended lanterns and flowing ribbons. Intricate cool-colored digital painting, luminous accents and clear focal faces without heavy bloom.
